content:
OST is not an Outlook data file: Full Guide to Fix Error Microsoft Outlook depends on the OST file for offline access, but the error “ .ost is not an Outlook data file ” occurs when it is not able to read it. The end users are facing the error , which requires fast fixes to Repair OST file Outlook 365 and other versions. In this blog, we will guide you about the error, its causes, location, how we can fix the " OST is not an Outlook data file” error, and much more. What is the “OST is not an Outlook data file” error? The OST is not an Outlook data file ; the error mainly appears with an error message as given below: C:\Users\owner\AppData\Local\Local\Microsoft\Outlook\Outlook Data File.ost is not an Outlook data file (.ost). The above error depicts that Outlook is not able to find or access the Offline Storage Table (OST) file, which gathers a durable copy of the mailbox for offline access. When the file becomes Outlook data file corruption , inaccessible, and unlinked from the Outlook profile, it can keep you away from opening Outlook or accessing emails, contacts, and calendars. What is an Outlook data file? Before getting to know how to repair Outlook data files, first, we need to understand what exactly an Outlook data file is. An Outlook data file is a local file on the desktop that gathers a copy of email messages, calendars, events, assignments, and contacts. Two types of Outlook data files are utilized by Outlook, and they are: ● OST (Offline Storage Table) Outlook Data File ● PST (Personal Storage Table) Outlook Data File Now, let’s get to know the difference between the OST File and the PST file for your better understanding. Given below are presented simply: Feature OST File (.ost) PST File (.pst) Full Name Offline Storage Table Personal Storage Table

Purpose Offline access to Exchange/Office 365 mailboxes; auto-syncs with server Local storage, backups, archiving emails from POP3/IMAP Sync Automatic Manual Server Dependency Tied to Exchange 365 Works independently Accessibility Profile-specific Opens in any Outlook profile easily File Size Limit Set by server (often over 50GB); grows with sync Up to 50GB in modern Outlook Offline Use Yes, cached copy for offline work Yes, fully local but no server sync Portability Not portable Highly portable Security/Encrypti on Encrypted with MAPI key Password-protected (CRC) Corruption Risk Lower Higher Best For Cached Exchange mode users Archiving or non-Exchange accounts If you want to experience and use our tool, convert OST to PST online . You can visit there and help you convert the OST file to a PST file.

What causes the “OST is not an Outlook data file” Error? There are several reasons why the .ost is not an outlook data file . It happens mostly because of the cohesion issues. So, let’s discuss below the causes of the error: OST is not an Outlook data file - ● The OST file can be very large in size. ● In the OST file, there is damage or corruption. ● Synchronization problem between the Exchange server and Outlook. ● There can be malware or a virus from a third party. ● The sudden or forced system shutdown. ● Unexpected power cut problem. ● Also, from the Outlook profile, those are faulty. When these errors show the above reasons, then prevent from deleting your profile immediately. Instead, try the repairing methods for fixing .ost is not an Outlook data file. It can save you from a big loss. Outlook OST File Location Don’t know how to identify the Outlook OST file location? Do not worry, you just need to follow a few simple steps: File ➡ Account Settings ➡ Data Files ➡ Open File Location Many users have a dilemma in finding out that Ost is not an Outlook data file Windows 10, Ost is not an Outlook data file Outlook 365 , and Ost is not an Outlook data file Windows 7 . Let’s see below to find out the location in different versions: OS/Version Default Path Windows 10 C:\Users[username]\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook[email].ost Windows 7 C:\Users[username]\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook[email].ost Outlook 365 Same as Windows 10 How to Fix the "OST is not an Outlook data file” Error? To repair Outlook data files is quite challenging because it involves troubleshooting and highlighting the issues of the error. Here are some of the simple methods given below: Update your Windows and Restart You have to make sure that your Windows operating system is updated. Sometimes, what happens is that pending window updates take you to the Outlook errors. To monitor for updates and install downloaded updates, you need to follow some steps: ● Go to settings and choose Windows Update. ● Download any pending updates ● Restart your desktop

● Open Outlook to view if the error has been removed. Fix Your Outlook Profile Due to Outlook data file corruption in the Outlook profile, cause problems with the OST File. Just follow the steps given below: ● Visit the file and account settings in Outlook 2010, 2013, 2016, and 2019. ● Click on the Email section and choose your profile account. ● Then, press on the repair alternative. ● Follow the directions. ● Now, restart Outlook and monitor the error. Generate a Fresh Outlook Profile Generating a fresh Outlook profile can sometimes resolve the issue that the OST is not an Outlook data file. If you don’t know how to create a new profile, check the steps below: ● Go to the control panel and search for the Mail. ● Press on the show profiles. ● Click on add account and fill in a name for the new profile creation. ● Now, add a new profile from the alternatives and enable the use profile. ● Then, restart your Outlook again by selecting the new profile. Disable Cached Exchange Method Disabling the cached exchange method can help solve the problem, but you won’t be able to use Outlook Offline. Let’s see the steps below in a precise manner: ● Visit the file and then the account settings. ● Choose your Outlook profile and press Change. ● Go to the option, uncheck the use cached exchange mode, and press next. ● When a pop-up appears, click on complete. ● Restart Outlook to monitor if the issue gets solved. Regenerate Outlook OST File You can generate a fresh OST file by removing the OST data file from the inaccessible location to the other location. ● Go to the file and then account settings. ● Press the data files and choose the OST file related to the profile. ● Click on the file location, and it will open a new file explorer window, showcasing the OST location of the file. ● Shut down Outlook, now click on the right side OST file and select delete. ● Go to Outlook, and it will regenerate a new OST file automatically.

Utilize Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant If the problem still appears, you can also utilize the Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant, which is a tool that can detect and solve the problems: ● Install Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant. ● Now open the utility. ● Choose Outlook from the alternatives and press Next. ● Select Outlook won’t start and press Next. ● Navigate the instructions that appear to solve the problem with the OST Outlook file. Conclusion The “ OST is not an Outlook data file ” is caused by several reasons, such as a large OST file size, a corrupted OST file, synchronization issues, a virus from a third party, sudden shutdown, and many more. While some methods like updating Windows and restarting, fixing, and generating a new Outlook profile, also using Microsoft support and recovery assistant can solve your problem.
